_note: This skill's checked-in routing corpus. WHAT IT IS: a LEXICAL-OVERLAP legibility aid, NOT a verdict — routing-eval scores surface token overlap only (see meta-skills/skills/routing-decomposer). Positives span the invocation families (imperative / diagnostic 'is this extraction faithful' / symptom 'the model invented values' / object-first 'grade this JSON against the document' / indirect-paraphrase 'is this structured output hallucinated'); the indirect/paraphrase positives are deliberately low-overlap and the proxy MAY MISS them — a measurement limit, not a description defect. Negatives are drawn ADVERSARIALLY from CONFUSABLE in-repo siblings to surface precision collisions: extraction-decomposer collides hardest with type-decomposer — NOTE EXPLICITLY: extraction AND type BOTH involve JSON Schema (extraction runs schema-check against an LLM extraction; type runs legal/illegal instance sets against a schema to make illegal states unrepresentable), so a bare 'JSON Schema' or 'validate this against the schema' request is a real collision and both fences must hold. extraction also collides with query-decomposer (SQL/DDL) and code-decomposer (a unit of code). Re-derive when the neighbourhood changes.
